Interface Argument

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractTransform, AreaCmd, ArgSet, CameraInfoCmd, CopyCmd, DistanceCmd, EchoCmd, EndCmd, ExitCmd, FilesCmd, LineJoin, ListCmd, LookAtCmd, OrbitCmd, PasteCmd, QuickTranslateCmd, RandomUUIDCmd, RecordCmd, RotateSelection, RunCmd, ScaleSelection, Subcommand, TeleportCmd, TestCmd, ToggleCmd, ToggleVisCmd, TranslateSelection, TriangleCmd, TypedArg, TypeOf, VolumeCmd
public interface Argument
Defines the contract for a command argument in the command processing system.

An Argument represents a parameter that can be passed to a command, complete with its name, a description for help menus, and whether it is required or optional. This interface is the base for more specific argument types, such as ArgSet.
